title: Apple launches its Health AI Usage Study, with an OpenEvidence-powered app that answers health questions and can use HealthKit data, for up to 200,000 US users (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch: Apple launches its Health AI Usage Study, with an OpenEvidence-powered app that answers health questions and can use HealthKit data, for up to 200,000 US users — Big AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic have made their bets on offering chatbots that can answer health-related queries with specialized features.
